title: Transposition of the specified compact-support compositor
statement: Fix the finite purity datum $P$, level $n$, separated finite-type base $B$ with structure map $a_B$, and $r\in\mathbb N$, as in [def-pur-coordinate-section-arrows]. For any arrow $\alpha:Rz_{r,!}A_B\to W_r$, transposing the specified coordinate compact-support compositor followed by $Rs_{r,!}\alpha$ and the last-section arrow gives the $z_r$-transpose of $\alpha$, followed by $Rz_r^!$ of the last-section adjunct and the specified coordinate exceptional compositor. All sources, targets, proper projection comparisons and equality transports are exactly those of [def-pur-coordinate-section-arrows] and [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. There is no supported-product identity or rank-zero assertion.

proof.text: Put f=zero B r, g=lastSection B r, h=zero B (r+1), e=zero_successor and beta=sectionArrow. Eliminate e. For t the g-transpose of beta and v the f-transpose of alpha followed by f^!t, inverse transposition and naturality give f_!v followed by its counit equal to alpha followed by t. The other inverse-transposition equation is g_!t followed by its counit equal to beta. Naturality of originCompositionAmbient at v therefore identifies its inverse component followed by g_!alpha and beta with (fg)_!v followed by the inverse component at f^!g^!L and the pasted counits. Forward transposition extracts v by source naturality. The remaining transpose is precisely compositionInverse by definition. Reintroduce e using the functor congruence maps. These formulas also apply to zero objects and empty schemes. Unfold only the recorded coordinate comparison definitions and sectionAdjunct to identify these general arrows with the displayed equation.

lean.statement:
theorem coordinateAdjunction_composition (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (B : Scheme.{u}) (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB] [IsSeparated aB] (r : ℕ)
    (alpha : (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (setting P n).Coefficient)
      (zero B r)).obj (unit P n B) ⟶ target P n _ r) :
    let := tower_noetherian (setting P n) B aB r
    let := tower_noetherian (setting P n) B aB (r + 1)
    rightDerivedUpperShriekHomEquiv (zero B (r + 1)) (unit_origin P n B)
      (target_plus P n _ (towerBase aB (r + 1)) (r + 1))
      ((coordinateComposition P n B r).hom ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (setting P n).Coefficient)
          (lastSection B r)).map alpha ≫ sectionArrow P n B aB r) =
      rightDerivedUpperShriekHomEquiv (zero B r) (unit_origin P n B)
        (target_plus P n _ (towerBase aB r) r) alpha ≫
        (rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (setting P n).Coefficient)
          (zero B r)).map (sectionAdjunct P n B aB r) ≫
        coordinateExceptionalComposition P n B aB r
